He ended in English 'most days'; أغلب 'Most' + plural of يوم 'Day' both on list.
Listening: took ما (not) as مع; she said 'ما, not مع'. Negation ما as in list 'Ma ma3i' (there's no ... with me).
Read إله as 'whatever'; she said No. إل- 'belongs to' as in list 'الشرف الي' (the pleasure is mine), with his/its ending.
Read إلي (mine) as relative اللي; she corrected with 'هذا الكتاب إلي'. Same إلي 'mine' as list 'الشرف الي'.

arabic: ما إله طعم = it doesn't have a taste
reason: Could not give 'it has no taste'; ما negation (list 'Ma ma3i') + إله + طعم 'taste' (list 6a3em) all on list.
Said خفيف (light) for autumn; she contrasted خفيف vs خريف. List 'El-5areef / الخريف' Autumn.

list_match: huwwe bada / هو بدأ + huwwe ballash / هو بلش
reason: She rejected his word for 'started' and hinted to بدأ; list 'He began بدأ' and 'He started بلش'.
Glossed خيار as 'mistakes'; she said Options. List 'Option - options / خيار' (not the cucumber row).
Answered 'booking' with موعد (appointment); she rejected it and gave حجز = list 'Booking / reservation'.
Offered طلب (order) for 'book a room'; she said no and gave حجز / أحجز = list 'Booking' + 'I book'.
Put a feminine ending on منظر (منظرة); she said it is masculine. List 'View / Scenery / منظر'.
Heard فطور as فول and answered about beans; she said 'فطور مش فول'. List 'Ftur / فطور' Breakfast.
Heard عنا as أنا ('with me'); she said with us / at ours. عند+نا = list '3end / عند' By / At (also kaan 3inna).

arabic: كمان نص ساعة = in half an hour (after half an hour)
list_match: Kamaan Shwai / كمان شوي + Noss / نص + Saa3a / ساعة
reason: Read كمان نص ساعة as 'half hour more'; she said No. كمان + time as in list 'Kamaan Shwai' (in a little while) + نص Half + ساعة Hour.
She asked 'شو يعني paper' after his English; he produced ورقة on the hint. List 'Waraqa / ورقة' Paper.
Quizzed نسينا, he guessed مصيبة / نصيب; she gave نسينا. List 'We forgot / إحنا نسينا'.
He asked if مصاري works for cash; she gave the loanword 'cash' (بدفع cash). مصاري 'Money' is on list but 'cash' is not.

list_match: Ana beddi / أنا بدي + Ana bashki (min) / أنا بشكي
reason: She swapped لازم for بدي: أنا بدي أشكي; list 'Ana beddi / أنا بدي' + 'Ana bashki / أنا بشكي'.
Used سألت (asked a question) for 'asked for'; she prompted and he fixed to طلبت. List 'Ana 6alabet / أنا طلبت'.
Could not place تذاكر, guessed 'appointment'; she said تذكرة is a ticket. List 'Tazkara / تذكرة' (pl تذاكر).

arabic: مين بيحجزلك = who books for you
reason: Glossed مين بيحجزلك as 'how do I book'; the missed word is مين 'who', not on list (بحجز is).
Said تزكر without the -a; her chat types his form 'el-tazkar' and she typed 'tazkara'. List 'Tazkara / تذكرة'.
Asked for the plural of تذكرة; she gave تذاكر = list plural 'tazaaker (تذاكر)'.
His word for 'before' drew a No; she gave قبل. List 'qabel / قبل' Before.
Used قريبًا (soon) for 'close to'; she said it doesn't work, قريب من. List 'Close / قريب' + 'From / من'.
Offered tazkara (ticket) for 'booking'; she said that's ticket, he found حجز. List 'Booking / reservation'.
Said مش لازم تذكر; her chat restores 'mish laazem tazkara'. List 'Tazkara / تذكرة'.
He had already said على بيت himself (53:14), then only asked if they say 'cabin'; she answered 'Just بيت or شاليه' - his بيت (list House) was accepted.
Could not recall 'passenger'; she gave راكب. List 'Raakeb / راكب' Passenger.
Forgot 'driver'; she hinted بسوق and gave سواق. List 'Sawwaa2 / سواق' Driver.
Asked how to say 'take turns'; she gave نوخذ دور / بالدور. دور 'turn' not on list (only لف 'turn' as rotate).
Asked how to say 'two hours away'; she prompted far and built بعيد ساعتين. List 'Far / بعيد' + dual of 'Hour / ساعة'.
Stacked أعمل + أخلص; she made him pick أخلص. List 'Ana ba5alles / أنا بخلص' I finish.
Misheard كيف الجو as about clothes; she repeated الجو twice. List 'Jaww / جو' Weather.
Asked for 'percent'; بالمية means percent - list has only مية 'a hundred', a different meaning.
Groped 'sne/stan' for teeth; she supplied أسنان. List 'Doctoar snan / دكتور سنان' Dentist (سنان = teeth).
Coined 'foot doctor'; she said bones doctor (دكتور عظام). دكتور on list but عظام 'bones' is not.
Did not know 'brain doctor'; she gave دماغ. Not on list (list has عقل 'Mind / Brain', a different word).
Said تم (mouth) for stomach doctor; she said Stomach and he switched to بطن. List 'Bâ6en / بطن'.
She taught دكتور نفسي (psychologist); list نفس is 'Breath', not 'psychological'.
Asked for 'general doctor'; she gave عام = general. List has عام only in 'كل عام وانت بخير' (year).

list_match: huwwe bada / هو بدأ + Ana babda / أنا ببدا
reason: Said دبا (letters swapped; engine wrote جاب, Amal's echo shows دبا); she gave بدأ. List 'He began / بدأ', 'I start / ببدا'.
Said ما وافى for 'didn't stop'; she gave وقف. List 'Wa2ef / وقف' Stop.

list_match: Ana bastanna / أنا بستنى + Daqeeqa / دقيقة (دقيقتين
reason: Heard تستنى دقيقة as ستة وستين; she said No and repeated. List 'I wait / بستنى' + 'Minute / دقيقة'.
Offered بسيطة (no big deal) for 'of course'; she led him to طبعًا / أكيد. List 'Akeed / أكيد'.
Said أسابيع (weeks) for fingers; she said 'is weeks'. أصابع is list plural 'Asaabe3' of 'Osba3 / أصبع'.
Said إجر (leg) meaning 'big body'; she said أجر is leg. List 'Jissem / جسم' Body.
Said واطيات (low) for short legs; she glossed 'Low legs' and he switched to قصيرات. List 'Qaseer / قصير'.
Said العروس (bride) for wedding; عرس 'wedding' not on list.
Guessed groom as عروسين; she gave عريس. 'Groom' not on list.
For 'probably' she gave على الأغلب; list أغلب is 'Most', the idiom 'most likely' is a different meaning.
Groped for 'like' (شيكي لو); on her 'Like' he produced زي. List 'zayy / زي' Like.
Said تنانين (dragons) for skirts; she recast تنانير = plural of list 'Tannoora / تنورة' Skirt.
He asked her to repeat/explain بتضايقني; taught pair بضايق / بتضايق = list 'Ana badaaye2 / أنا بدايق' (I upset someone).
He said كلسات, the list word 'Socks (Plural)'; she offered her dialect جرابين but said 'كلسات is nice. It's better than جرابين' - he was right.
Said ولاد (kids) for 'when you were little'; she gave صغيرة. List 'Z8eer / صغير' Small.
Said خصلات (locks) after 'I forgot the word'; she recast كلسات. List 'Kalsaat / كلسات' Socks.
Said الكل (everyone) for 'everything'; she said عن كل شي. List 'Kul shee / كل شيء' Everything.
